2. Incorporate subtle Cumbia references (e.g., rhythm patterns, trumpet silhouettes) without overwhelming the text.

- Prioritize the neighborhood synergy through abstract cityscapes.  
- Balance text and visual elements with pearly white accents.  
- Integrate cultural motifs (e.g., traditional patterns) with modern cursive."
